VERDICT: The test creates a Grafo locally and inserts edges into that instance only; there is no evidence of global/static state modification or persistent external resources. No explicit teardown is required for local-only state. Therefore compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification:
PRINCIPLE: Use labels/categories (@Tag, @Category) to organize tests for selective execution.
RATIONALE: Labels enable targeted runs and improve CI efficiency.
EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant if @Tag/@Category or equivalent appear with meaningful values.
DECISION RULES: 1) Look for @Tag/@Category. 2) Check if labels are meaningful. 3) If none present, non-compliant.
VERDICT: The class is annotated with @Category(UnitTest.class) at the class level. This is a meaningful categorization indicating unit tests. Therefore compliant.
